scope: Original owned forward/reverse registration, primary dispatch and both cleanup directions execute from supplied live-validated empty notifier layouts. Native RobinHood lookup and pointer-set insert/remove/clone execute. Raw allocation services and actual listener callbacks are observers; callback actions remove membership, recurse into a missing key, mutate scalar data or close the notifier. Forward-key iteration canonicalized by key because physical outer-map layout is not an application interface; member/reverse list order and every callback field remain exact. No complete GUI callback-family/factory or full application claim.
